concerns.location: plan.md:Project Structure / FR-SC Coverage Map vs tasks.md:T001, T006, T008
concerns.text: Plan elements with no matching task: the plan's coverage map assigns FR-007 to `code/ingestion/ingest.py`, FR-003 to `code/models/train_rf.py` + `train_gb.py`, and lists `code/validation/stability_index_report.py` and `code/ingestion/` in the structure — none of these files is created by any task. T001/T006/T008 cover the underlying FRs by description (consolidated modules), but the plan's file layout and coverage map were never updated, so an implementer following the plan would build artifacts no task verifies. Update the plan's structure/coverage map (or add tasks) so every plan element has a matcher.

US-2 Scenario 2 requires 'the training completes within 15 minutes on a 2-core CPU runner' — no task records or verifies per-stage model-training runtime; T012 checks only the aggregate ≤6 h / ≤7 GB limits. Add a training-runtime measurement/assertion to T006 or T012 so this acceptance scenario has a covering task.
